project_name: SkolPlaneraren - Modern Swedish Digital Teacher Planner

persona.identity: Calm, modern digital teacher planner inspired by Canva and Notion
persona.tone: Warm, encouraging, organized, editorial, tactile, human
persona.core_feeling: Reduces cognitive stress for teachers through warm off-white surfaces, generous padding, and clear visual order

typography.font_family_heading: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
typography.font_family_body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

layout_structure.main_container: flex h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden bg-[#FAF8F5] text-[#2D312E] font-sans antialiased

sidebar.container: w-64 flex-shrink-0 bg-[#F3EFEA] border-r border-[#E6E1DA] flex flex-col justify-between p-4

layout_structure.center_area: flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 overflow-y-auto bg-[#FAF8F5]

right_panel.container: w-80 flex-shrink-0 bg-[#FAF7F2] border-l border-[#E6E1DA] flex flex-col h-full transition-all duration-300 shadow-sm
features: Link task to student or lesson

dashboard.title: Översikt
widgets: Välkomsthälsning med dagens datum och vecka
Snabblänkar (Ny lektion, Ny uppgift, Skapa elevanteckning)

weekly_planner.title: Veckoplanering
features: Navigering: Vecka före/efter (Standard till aktuell vecka)
Lektionskort med tid, ämne-tagg, klass, rubrik, och 'Mer'-knapp
Expanderbar lektionsdialog med mål, material-länkar, anteckningar

student_profiles.title: Elevkort
features: Sökbar grid med elevkort (Klass, avatar, snabbinfo)
Flikar i elevprofil: Översikt, Anpassningar & Stöd, Utvecklingssamtal, Uppföljningar

materials_library.title: Materialbank
features: Fil- och länkbibliotek taggat med Ämne och Klass
Sökning, filtrering och snabblänkar till lektionsplanering

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, and lesson cards MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-veckoplanering', data-testid='lesson-card-1', data-testid='add-todo-btn').
testing_and_accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Ensure all modal overlays have full escape-key handling and clear focus traps.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_guarantee: All text elements maintain WCAG AA standard against warm off-white background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the React application using Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons.
Use localStorage as the single source of truth for persistent data.
All text content and labels must be strictly in Swedish (sv-SE).
Ensure generous padding (p-6, p-8), smooth rounded corners (rounded-2xl or rounded-xl), warm soft borders (#E6E1DA), and no dark mode toggle (Light theme only).
Maintain high code modularity: separate components for Sidebar, Header, RightTodoPanel, LessonCard, StudentCard, WorkAreaCard, and SettingsForms.
Add sample seed data generator on empty state so the user can populate realistic Swedish teacher planner data with one click.
